mapper.insert: INSERT INTO journey_member_cap(tenant_id,journey_id,member_id) VALUES(#{tenant},#{journey},#{member}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE member_id=member_id
mapper.select: SELECT entry_window,entries,notification_window,notifications FROM journey_member_cap WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND journey_id=#{journey} AND member_id=#{member} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE journey_member_cap SET notification_window=#{window},notifications=#{count},suppressed_notifications=suppressed_notifications+IF(#{suppressed},1,0)entry_window=#{window},entries=#{count},suppressed_entries=suppressed_entries+IF(#{suppressed},1,0) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND journey_id=#{journey} AND member_id=#{member}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM journey_effect WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND effect_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE)

SELECT FROM journey_definition WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND status='PUBLISHED' AND trigger_type=#{trigger} AND store_id=#{store} AND valid_from<=#{now} AND valid_to>#{now} AND valid_from<=#{occurred} AND valid_to>#{occurred} AND published_at<=#{occurred} ORDER BY journey_id LIMIT 11

SELECT journey_id,SUM(kind='ENROLLED') enrolled,SUM(kind='COMPLETED') completed,SUM(kind='NOTIFIED') notified,SUM(kind='ENTRY_SUPPRESSED') entry_suppressed,SUM(kind='NOTIFY_SUPPRESSED') notification_suppressed FROM journey_effect WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{store} AND created_at>=#{from} AND created_at<#{to} AND journey_id>#{after} GROUP BY journey_id ORDER BY journey_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM journey_definition WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND journey_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
SELECT FROM journey_definition WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND journey_id=#{id} ORDER BY version FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM journey_definition d WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND journey_id > #{after} AND version=(SELECT MAX(v.version) FROM journey_definition v WHERE v.tenant_id=d.tenant_id AND v.journey_id=d.journey_id) ORDER BY journey_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM journey_definition WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND store_id=#{store} AND status='PUBLISHED' AND trigger_type='ORDER_PAID' AND valid_from <= #{now} AND valid_to > #{now} ORDER BY journey_id LIMIT 11
mapper.update: UPDATE journey_definition SET status='PAUSED',lock_version=lock_version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND journey_id=#{id} AND status='PUBLISHED'

UPDATE journey_definition SET status=#{status},lock_version=lock_version+1,published_at=IF(#{status}='PUBLISHED',UTC_TIMESTAMP(3),published_at) WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND journey_id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND lock_version=#{expected}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO journey_instance(tenant_id,instance_id,journey_id,journey_version,member_id,order_id,event_key,current_node,due_at,deadline) VALUES(#{tenant},#{id},#{definition.journeyId},#{definition.version},#{member},#{order},#{event},#{definition.entry},#{now},#{deadline}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE instance_id=instance_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM journey_instance WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND journey_id=#{journey} AND journey_version=#{version} AND event_key=#{event} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM journey_instance WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND instance_id=#{id}
SELECT FROM journey_instance WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND instance_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.sql: (status IN ('RUNNING','WAITING') AND due_at <= #{now} OR status IN ('RUNNING','WAITING','ISOLATED') AND deadline <= #{now})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM journey_instance WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND instance_id=#{id} AND FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
SELECT FROM journey_instance WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND instance_id > #{after} ORDER BY instance_id LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT FROM journey_instance WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND order_id=#{order} ORDER BY instance_id LIMIT 11 FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id FROM (SELECT DISTINCT tenant_id FROM journey_instance WHERE tenant_id > #{after} AND UNION SELECT s.tenant_id FROM journey_lifecycle_scan s JOIN journey_definition d ON d.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND d.journey_id=s.journey_id AND d.version=s.journey_version WHERE s.tenant_id>#{after} AND s.status<>'ISOLATED' AND s.next_due<=#{now} AND d.status='PUBLISHED' AND d.valid_from<=#{now} AND d.valid_to>#{now}) t ORDER BY tenant_id LIMIT 4
SELECT FROM journey_instance WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND ORDER BY due_at,instance_id LIMIT 5
mapper.update: UPDATE journey_instance SET current_node=#{node},status=#{status},due_at=#{due},result=#{result},steps=steps+1,attempts=0,version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND instance_id=#{previous.instanceId} AND version=#{previous.version}

UPDATE journey_instance SET status=IF(attempts+1 >= 5,'ISOLATED','RUNNING'),attempts=attempts+1,due_at=#{due},result='NODE_FAILED',version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND instance_id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status IN ('RUNNING','WAITING')
UPDATE journey_instance SET status=#{status},attempts=0,due_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND instance_id=#{id} AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT notification_id,title,body,created_at FROM journey_notification WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND member_id=#{member} AND notification_id > #{after} ORDER BY notification_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO journey_lifecycle_scan(tenant_id,journey_id,journey_version,created_before,next_due) VALUES(#{tenant},#{definition.journeyId},#{definition.version},#{now},GREATEST(#{now},#{definition.validFrom})) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE journey_id=journey_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM journey_lifecycle_scan s WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND journey_id=#{id} AND journey_version=#{version} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM journey_lifecycle_scan s JOIN journey_definition d ON d.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND d.journey_id=s.journey_id AND d.version=s.journey_version WHERE s.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND s.status<>'ISOLATED' AND s.next_due<=#{now} AND d.status='PUBLISHED' AND d.valid_from<=#{now} AND d.valid_to>#{now} ORDER BY s.next_due,s.journey_id,s.journey_version LIMIT 5

SELECT FROM journey_lifecycle_scan s WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND journey_id>#{after} AND journey_version=(SELECT MAX(v.journey_version) FROM journey_lifecycle_scan v WHERE v.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND v.journey_id=s.journey_id) ORDER BY journey_id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE journey_lifecycle_scan SET status=#{status},member_cursor=#{cursor},created_before=#{before},next_due=#{due},scanned=scanned+#{scanned},enrolled=enrolled+#{enrolled},attempts=0,error_code=NULL,version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND journey_id=#{previous.journeyId} AND journey_version=#{previous.journeyVersion} AND version=#{previous.version}

UPDATE journey_lifecycle_scan SET status=IF(attempts+1>=5,'ISOLATED',status),attempts=attempts+1,error_code='SCAN_FAILED',next_due=#{due},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND journey_id=#{previous.journeyId} AND journey_version=#{previous.journeyVersion} AND version=#{previous.version} AND status<>'ISOLATED'

UPDATE journey_lifecycle_scan SET status=IF(member_cursor='','IDLE','RUNNING'),attempts=0,error_code=NULL,next_due=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND journey_id=#{previous.journeyId} AND journey_version=#{previous.journeyVersion} AND version=#{previous.version}
mapper.select: SELECT lifecycle_anchor FROM journey_instance WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND instance_id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE journey_instance SET lifecycle_anchor=#{at} WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND instance_id=#{id}
